content: I'm software developer living in Zagreb, Croatia. I finished college education at Algebra with bachelor's degree in computer science. I'm currently working at Dhimahi making software solutions for ticket distribution.

projects.name: Bar Assistant
projects.info_html: Bar Assistant is an all-in-one solution for managing your home bar. This managed Bar Assistant includes a landing page and custom server infrastructure.
